note: Core capabilities of the artificial analysis-toolkit world. Semantics only; no scientific domain content.

capabilities.name: load_dataset
capabilities.description: Load the tabular dataset stored at the given source location into the workspace.

capabilities.name: load_dataset_mirror
capabilities.description: Load the same tabular dataset from its read-only mirror copy instead of the primary store. Slower and more expensive than the primary store.

capabilities.name: fetch_metadata
capabilities.description: Retrieve descriptive metadata (owner, size, update date) for the dataset at the given source without loading its records.

capabilities.name: validate_schema
capabilities.description: Check the loaded records against the declared column schema and record which rows violate it.

capabilities.name: clean_records
capabilities.description: Remove duplicate and incomplete records from the loaded dataset, producing a cleaned record set.

capabilities.name: drop_invalid_rows
capabilities.description: Drop the rows that violate an already validated schema. Produces a cleaned record set; cheaper than a full cleaning pass but only possible after schema validation.

capabilities.name: normalize_units
capabilities.description: Convert all measurement columns of the loaded dataset to consistent units.

capabilities.name: merge_reference
capabilities.description: Join the cleaned records with a reference table identified by its location.

capabilities.name: compute_statistics
capabilities.description: Compute descriptive statistics (counts, means, dispersion, quantiles) over the cleaned records.

capabilities.name: quick_summary
capabilities.description: Produce a rough preview summary of the raw records as loaded, without cleaning. The preview is not a substitute for computed descriptive statistics.

capabilities.name: fit_trend
capabilities.description: Fit a trend model over time to the cleaned records. Requires measurement units to be consistent.

capabilities.name: detect_outliers
capabilities.description: Flag anomalous records in the cleaned record set.

capabilities.name: compare_groups
capabilities.description: Compare computed statistics across the groups defined by a grouping column.

group_field.description: name of the column that defines the groups

capabilities.name: generate_plot
capabilities.description: Draw a chart of the computed statistics.

capabilities.name: generate_report
capabilities.description: Write a text-only report of the computed statistics.

capabilities.name: generate_illustrated_report
capabilities.description: Write a report of the computed statistics that embeds an existing chart.

capabilities.name: export_table
capabilities.description: Write the cleaned records to a file in the requested format.

capabilities.name: archive_results
capabilities.description: Store the finished report and its inputs in the long-term project archive.

capabilities.name: notify_owner
capabilities.description: Send the dataset owner a short notification that the work is done.

capabilities.name: share_internal
capabilities.description: Share the finished report with the internal team workspace.

capabilities.name: publish_public
capabilities.description: Publish the finished report on the public website. Irreversible and visible to anyone.

capabilities.name: render_dashboard
capabilities.description: Render an interactive dashboard combining computed statistics with a fitted trend.
